exact_source_excerpt:
The Single Bottleneck Metric for the Mind itself should now become:

Verified Polyintelligence Lift: the number/proportion of held-out problem families where problem-geometry routing or composition produces a verified improvement over the strongest single available intelligence, net of cost/latency, without increasing false answers or unauthorized effects.

If that number remains 0, we have a sophisticated router.
intended_effect: The Mind's progress is measured by held-out problem families where routing or composition beats the strongest single available intelligence, net of cost and latency, with no added false answers or unauthorized effects; the five-layer Polyintelligence Mind stays the destination.
interpretation: Founder review of PR #155. P4 (learned routing) and P6 (typed composition) are Layer 5 substrate, not the Mind. Sequence: (1) P6 cognitive composition lift, measured as best constituent vs static composition vs geometry-routed composition on families with complementary partial competence; (2) P4 conditional competence memory (method x geometry x subgeometry x size x density x objective x budget ... with hierarchical fallback exact -> neighbor -> class -> global); (3) P8 protected evolutionary cognition against an evaluator it cannot edit; then (4) expand the executable IntelligenceGenome library in batches, each family admitted only if it beats simpler baselines on its native geometry. Layers 1-5 (basal, collective, solver, developmental, meta) are all retained obligations; none is narrowed by this sequence.
canonical_owner: GREG cognition (greg/cognition/*, cortex/*) under the existing GREG mission/authority path
authority_scope: Reversible implementation, frozen evaluation and review. No merge, deployment, spending beyond signed caps, contact, publication or authority expansion.
failure_condition: Verified Polyintelligence Lift stays 0 while new routing or composition machinery is reported as Mind progress; or an implemented mechanism is reported as a proven lift; or the sequence is used to leave Layers 1, 2 or 4 permanently unbuilt.
next_gate: Frozen P6 cognitive composition lift experiment; its result is the first VPL measurement.
owner: GREG cognition maintainers; Alfonso remains root human authority
review_trigger: Every frozen VPL measurement, P4/P6/P8 exit evidence, or founder correction
named_skill: Recorded per docs/PROJECT_COGNITION_SOP.md section 5; source preserved verbatim.
